Let \(h=AD\), \(\alpha=\angle BAD\), \(\beta=\angle CAD\). Then
\[
\tan\alpha=\frac{3}{h},\qquad \tan\beta=\frac{2}{h}.
\]
Since \(\alpha+\beta=45^\circ\),
\[
\tan(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{\frac3h+\frac2h}{1-\frac3h\cdot\frac2h}=1.
\]
Thus
\[
\frac{5/h}{1-6/h^2}=1
\]
so
\[
5h=h^2-6 \implies h^2-5h-6=0 \implies h=6.
\]
The area is
\[
x=\frac12\cdot BC\cdot AD=\frac12\cdot 5\cdot 6=15.
\]
\[
\boxed{15}
\]
